purpose: Teach: 脳死/永続/双方向/包囲/落選/兵力/没収/上告

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、脳死判定の手順を医療チームで厳守しております
lines.en: Ren, we follow the brain-death protocol strictly within our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Slight formal weight on 'strictly.' Steady eye contact. No hurry, no hesitation—the voice of someone who has delivered difficult information before.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、慢性病の永続的な管理を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, our team manages the long-term care of chronic conditions.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Light emphasis on 'long-term.' Voice sits at chest level—grounded, unhurried. The reassurance of competence stated plainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 双方向の医療相談アプリを、貴院、ご導入されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital introduced a two-way medical consultation app, sensei?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity. Lifting tone at the end—genuine interest, not testing. A slight pause before 'two-way' as if noticing something thoughtful about the system itself.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染症の包囲対策を医療チームで強化しました
lines.en: Yes, we've strengthened our infection control measures across the team.
lines.style: Direct and factual. Slight quickening on 'strengthened'—a note of deliberate action. Still measured, but with quiet weight behind it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 議員落選後の体調管理を、貴院、なさったそうですね、先生
lines.en: I hear your hospital provided health support after the politician's loss, sensei?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tentative. Respectful distance in the phrasing—he's asking about something he's heard, not accusing. Slight brightness in 'support,' like he's genuinely impressed by the care.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、災害時の医療兵力配置も医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes, we have disaster response protocols in place across our medical team.
lines.style: Steady, preparatory tone. Voice carries the weight of planning and readiness without drama. Each phrase sits level—this is routine preparation, not alarm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医薬品の没収案件を、貴院、対応されたそうですね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital handled a case involving seized medication, sensei?
lines.style: Careful, almost cautious phrasing. Slight hesitation before 'seized'—he's aware this is sensitive. Voice stays level, respectful, seeking clarification without judgment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療訴訟の上告審にも医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Yes, we handle appeals in medical litigation cases as a unified team as well.
lines.style: Final statement—slightly slower pace, even more measured. Voice carries quiet authority without defensiveness. A small closing breath after 'as well,' like drawing a line beneath the conversation.
